name: zyceh
title: Zyceh
description: Automatically switch keyboard layout when the active app changes
author: artemi

commands.name: index
commands.title: Zyceh
commands.subtitle: Language Switcher
commands.description: Monitor the active app and enforce a keyboard layout for non-allowlisted apps

commands.name: configure
commands.title: Configure Zyceh
commands.description: View allowlisted apps and available input source IDs

preferences.name: allowlist
preferences.title: Ignored Apps
preferences.description: App names (comma-separated) whose keyboard layout is never touched

preferences.name: targetLayout
preferences.title: Enforced Layout ID
preferences.description: Input source ID to switch to for all other apps — open Configure to see available IDs

scripts.build:swift: swiftc scripts/input-source.swift -o assets/input-source && swiftc scripts/daemon.swift -o assets/daemon && chmod +x assets/input-source assets/daemon
